scientific_integrity: The sharp universal bound is proved by a complete elementary norm inequality. Exact finite arithmetic supports but does not prove universal quantifiers. No claim of independent validation or established publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Real Banach spaces of dimension at least two; the Birkhoff-restricted ratio only. Equality spaces beyond the stated examples and stability are not classified. Older synonymous literature cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: The sharp universal Birkhoff–Dehghan–Rooin bound is \(\sqrt{2}\)
